kill_condition.rule: pass if at least 1 country with apoha-set < 4/4 has exactly 1 failing NOT-blocker check (single-intervention candidate for eirmath); fail if no country has the single-blocker pattern (every non-apoha country has multiple blockers)
kill_condition.rationale: The single-blocker pattern is the methodology's diagnostic for 'cheapest intervention to flip country into apoha-set membership'. Eirmath would price the named intervention per country. This voice does not price; it identifies. The mechanical check is computable from country_apoha_suitability_v1's sidecar alone — no real-grid measurement, no private data.

verdict.rationale: Apoha-blocker diagnostic identifies 1 country/ies with exactly one failing NOT-blocker check: ['Iceland/NOT_transmission_constrained']. At the methodology layer, each is a single-intervention candidate whose cost eirmath would price separately. Multi-blocker countries (0): [] — these need composite interventions or are out-of-scope for the single-flip heuristic. Per §1 honesty bounds this voice does NOT price any intervention and does NOT claim the named intervention would in fact flip the country; it claims the methodology identifies single-blocker structural patterns mechanically.
